display_name: 源域 AdamW 双损失方向约束有限步诊断
description: 比较单步 AdamW 和投影后的实际源 IQ 与合成响应损失，不生成恢复模型。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: Local RTX 5070 Ti GPU0 deterministic FP32 TF32off source-only diagnostic

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: First 32 source physical IDs for source update and next 32 disjoint IDs for heldout source evaluation, each with three fixed views and 1% cubic amplitude perturbation
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: First 32 and next 32 disjoint ordered IDs of source context, each across epochs21/22/23
data.validation_ref: Disjoint 32 source fit IDs, same underlying source training pool and not V; not a target or generalization score

permissions.claim_scope: Single-step optimization mechanics on source synthetic responses; no target, TX identity, released checkpoint, or accuracy claim

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA and fixed 117062-parameter source correction initialization; one in-memory step per fresh optimizer
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact DURA source checkpoint, deterministic source context and matching source initialization/fit IDs; no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original DURA and source IQ context are F/TX/V/target free
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed source slices, two learning rates and final diagnostic; no target or V selection

execution.gpu_policy: Local GPU0 technical feasibility only; N607 remains the default for formal model training
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source contract mismatch, nonfinite value, invalid projection, or unavailable GPU

expected_artifacts: result.json: source-only initial and post-step loss and update geometry; no model weights

metric_names: realized projected step after FP32 rounding

rows.method: Fresh AdamW step versus projection of its actual displacement onto two source-gradient halfspaces
rows.purpose: Measure finite-step and heldout changes; no model is released
rows.seed_notes: Fixed source correction initialization 2026110612; deterministic first 32 source IDs; no new random draw
rows.scenario: three fixed source views, synthetic amplitude cubic at 1% RMS
rows.optimizer: Fresh AdamW with gradient norm clipping 1 and weight decay .001
rows.budget_ref: One in-memory step at each fixed lr 0.0003 and 0.00003; 32 source IDs plus 32 disjoint source IDs x three views

notes: Synthetic source response and source IQ objectives are averaged over the three fixed views.
Each learning rate resets the same fixed initialization and AdamW state; evaluate standard and projected updates on the same precomputed source contexts.
Projection uses the full actual AdamW parameter displacement, including clipping and weight decay; report both intended and FP32-realized directional cosines.
Thirty-two heldout source IDs are disjoint from update IDs but are not an independent dataset and may share ancestry with frozen DURA.
Each option is a single in-memory step. No trained recovery checkpoint or model version is saved; no F/TX/V/target is used.
A feasible first-order direction does not guarantee finite-step or heldout improvement and says nothing about Phase1 test accuracy.
